meta.title: Add event-specific T&Cs via 'Edit Terms and Conditions'

steps.note: Open a multi-stage event configuration screen so terms can be checked for stage-specific isolation.
Provide the required event title before interacting with the configuration.
Create two stages so the added terms can be verified against the other stage.
Open the event's terms configuration control.

args.goal: In the Terms and Conditions editor, select a recent or previously used T&C, manually enter a new term, upload a document if the editor requires or offers one, click Done, then verify that the event's T&C panel lists the added terms on the current stage and that the other stage of the same project does not show those added terms.

steps.note: Perform and verify the event-specific T&C workflow, including the stage-isolation oracle that no catalog step can express directly.
Confirm the configuration screen still exposes the T&C panel after the terms workflow completes.
